name: Frame Window Lab
description: Record a run, measure every click's frame window, and play it back with circles, counters and sounds.

circles.name: Click circles
circles.description: Draw a ring where each click happened, with its frame window above it.

counters.name: Frame counters
counters.description: Show the counter rows in the top left during playback, counting up as the clicks are played.

sounds.name: Click sounds
sounds.description: Play a cue for each click that gets a circle. Tighter windows sound lower; 1-frame clicks have their own bell.

show-releases.name: Show releases
show-releases.description: Releases are measured too. Turn this off to show and count presses only.

count-ship.name: Count ship clicks
count-ship.description: Off: ship clicks get no circle or sound and are left out of the counter, as in most frame window videos. They are still measured.

max-circle-frames.name: Max circle frames
max-circle-frames.description: Clicks wider than this get no circle and no sound. The counter still counts them.

count-fps.name: Count frames at
count-fps.description: Converts the measured duration using ticks x FPS / 240. Supports every value from 60 to 240, including 144 and 180. This changes display counts, not the 240 Hz physics.

round-windows-up.name: Round fractional frames up
round-windows-up.description: On: 5 ticks at 60 FPS displays as 2 frames (1.25 rounded up). Off: round down, with a minimum of 1, as in v1.0.0. This is a duration conversion, not a scan on a lower-FPS input grid.

count-open-windows.name: Count unfinished window bounds
count-open-windows.description: Include N+ windows in counter rows. Off by default: N+ is only a lower bound, so its exact counter row is unknown. Rings still show N+; increase Scan range and rescan to find the edge.

number-beside-ring.name: Number beside the ring
number-beside-ring.description: Puts each number beside its ring (left for a press, right for a release) instead of above it.

show-milliseconds.name: Milliseconds
show-milliseconds.description: Show each click's window in milliseconds under its ring. One tick at 240 is 4.2 ms.

number-scale.name: Number size
number-scale.description: Size of the frame number at each ring.

counter-rows.name: Rows
counter-rows.description: Comma-separated frame counts or ranges, such as 1,2,3,7-8,9+.

counter-colors.name: Colours
counter-colors.description: Optional: first frame of a row and a hex colour, such as 1:ff5468,5:60c8ff. Empty uses the built-in palette.

scan-range.name: Scan range (ticks)
scan-range.description: How far each click is moved to either side while measuring. Windows wider than the range read as N+.

check-ticks.name: Check length (ticks)
check-ticks.description: After a moved click, the run must survive this many ticks past the following inputs to pass. Longer is stricter and slower.

following-inputs.name: Following inputs
following-inputs.description: How many of the next inputs must also play out before the check length starts.

skip-useless.name: Leave out useless clicks
skip-useless.description: Remove each press and its release and replay to completion. Only if the level still finishes are both events left out of the counter. This always checks the whole run.

exact-scan.name: Exact scan
exact-scan.description: Recommended: replay from the start for every test to avoid incomplete checkpoint restoration. Off uses faster, approximate checkpoints; failed baseline checks retry from the start. Existing installations should enable this manually.

check-to-end.name: Require level completion
check-to-end.description: Recommended: a moved click passes only if the level actually finishes. Catches delayed deaths that short checks miss. Off uses Following inputs and Check length instead, which is faster but approximate.

resume-scan.name: Resume matching partial scans
resume-scan.description: Continue a cancelled scan only if its scan settings match. Off starts fresh. Completed scans always start fresh; recordings from v1.0.0 keep their inputs but must be rescanned.

scan-budget-ms.name: Scan time per frame (ms)
scan-budget-ms.description: How long the scan works each frame. Higher is faster but the game gets choppier while scanning.

sound-1.name: 1-frame sound
sound-1.description: Leave empty for the bundled cue.

sound-2.name: 2-frame sound
sound-2.description: Leave empty for the bundled cue.

sound-3.name: 3-frame sound
sound-3.description: Leave empty for the bundled cue.

sound-4.name: 4-frame sound
sound-4.description: Leave empty for the bundled cue.

sound-5.name: 5-frame sound
sound-5.description: Leave empty for the bundled cue.

sound-wide.name: Wide sound
sound-wide.description: Played for windows wider than 9 frames. Leave empty for the bundled cue.
